name: PEMS-BAY
description: Bay Area traffic speed from 325 sensors over about six months. MAE, RMSE, and MAPE at a 12-step horizon. Li et al., ICLR 2018 (DCRNN). Distinct from PEMS-03, PEMS-04, PEMS-07, PEMS-08, and METR-LA. Loader-only metadata.
citation: Li et al., ICLR 2018. PEMS-BAY traffic speeds.

license.notes: Caltrans open traffic data. Record only; no data vendored.
